schemaStability: Additive changes only within a major version: new properties and new CSV columns (appended, never inserted); no property is ever newly required. `congress` is carried in the metadata and as the last CSV column so a downloaded copy says which Congress it describes.
title: Georgia Federal Delegation — Nominees in Senate En Bloc Votes
description: The nominees covered by each Senate en bloc roll call of the Congress, one row per roll call per nominee. The Senate took one vote on the whole group: a senator's vote in votes.json applies to every nominee listed under that voteId and does not show a view on any one of them. The table holds no per-senator columns; join voteId to votes.json. Procedural votes on a group and its confirmation vote list the same nominees. A list is complete or absent: a roll call whose names are not yet available has no rows.

generatedAt.description: When the source lists last changed.

name.description: null when the title does not read 'name, of state, to be position'.
